English: Wooden Study Room
A humble wooden chamber, hastily assembled for study and prayer. Provides a gathering place for scholars and scribes in frontier lands.
Study Chamber
A modest, purpose-built chamber for advanced study, housing small collections of scrolls and manuscripts.
Stone Study House
A sturdy stone-walled house dedicated to study and scriptural discussion, offering protection for sacred texts and students.
Enclosed Study Hall
A well-fortified and expanded hall, providing secure space for scholars and increased capacity for learning and religious gatherings.
Decorated Study House
A beautifully adorned study house, with painted walls and improved storage for sacred books. Attracts respected teachers and scribes.
Blessed Study House
A house of learning famed for its blessed scholars and the wisdom produced within. Its influence extends throughout the realm.
Sanctified Study House
A study house consecrated by revered religious leaders, its halls echo with sacred learning and wisdom.
Ornate Study House
An elaborate center of study, featuring intricate woodwork and decorated halls. Serves as a beacon of learning and faith.
Grand Study House
A grand institution of religious study, attracting sages from across distant lands. Its halls are filled with rare texts and vibrant debate.
Great Synagogue Study House
A magnificent center of wisdom and faith, paired with the grandeur of a great synagogue. Its influence shapes the faith for generations.
